@mapAnomalyDirectionHigher.description: Direction supplied by the verified anomaly producer; no client threshold or sign inference.

@mapAnomalyDirectionLower.description: Lower direction supplied by the anomaly producer.

mapAnomalyDirectionNone: Direction: no change from the baseline

@mapAnomalyDirectionNone.description: Producer explicitly supplies no difference direction; never a substitute for unknown.

@mapAnomalyDirectionUnknown.description: Producer direction is unknown and must not be inferred from counts.

@mapAnomalyEligible.description: Producer explicitly confirms eligibility for its own baseline definition.

@mapAnomalyIneligible.description: Producer has excluded this observation from classification.

@mapAnomalyEligibilityUnknown.description: No producer eligibility conclusion is available.

@mapAnomalyClassified.description: Anomalous classification supplied by the producer, independent of display colour.

@mapAnomalyNotAnomalous.description: Explicit producer classification; an unclassified observation never receives this text.

@mapAnomalyUnclassified.description: Producer supplied no classification; absence of a baseline is not normal activity.

mapAnomalyCauseUnestablished: A difference from the baseline does not establish a cause.

@mapAnomalyCauseUnestablished.description: Anomaly comparison is not a causal explanation. This view does not invent possible causes or call AI.
